einzeiler: Weekly true crime headlines covering Lily Peters, missing children, and family murders.
kurzfassung: This episode reviews major true crime headlines from the week, including the plea deal in the Lily Peters murder case and a massive child recovery operation in Florida. The hosts also discuss recent family annihilator cases in Montana and Ohio, alongside trial updates for Lindsay Clancy. Finally, they touch upon the documentary coverage of Micah Miller's case.
stichpunkte: Carson pleads guilty to the 2022 murder of 10-year-old Lily Peters in Wisconsin, receiving life in prison with parole eligibility after 25 years.
Operation Statewide Shield in Florida successfully recovers 163 missing children over a five-day period.
A family annihilator case in Billings, Montana, leaves eight family members dead after a shooting and house fire.
An 18-year-old woman in Delaware County, Ohio, and her boyfriend are charged in connection with the murder of her mother.
The Lindsay Clancy trial in Massachusetts faces jury deadlock issues and deliberations over multiple possible verdicts.
Discussion on Netflix's documentary about Micah Miller and the details left out of the broadcast.

beschreibung:
This week on Headline Highlights: Carson Peters-Berger, who was 14 when he murdered his 10-year-old cousin Lily Peters, pleaded guilty to first-degree intentional homicide in a plea deal. Florida’s Operation Statewide Shield recovered 163 missing children in five days across the U.S. and abroad. A Billings, Montana man killed eight members of his family before taking his own life. An Ohio woman was allegedly murdered by her own daughter and her daughter’s boyfriend and roommate in a premeditated plot following a family argument. After five weeks of testimony, the Lindsay Clancy jury has reported that it is deadlocked and unable to reach a unanimous verdict, as the judge sends them back to deliberate again.
